Fighting Nazis and exploring secret bases is back in the spotlight, but now it all looks fresh and relevant thanks to high-quality textures and improved lighting.

The old arsenal has been supplemented with new, more powerful weapons, and modern engine capabilities add more dynamics to every battle. RealRTCW — is a chance to relive a story that began in 2001, but now opens up new horizons in a game on modern PCs.

Game features

Updated graphics with support for modern lighting technologies. Expanded arsenal of weapons with new capabilities. Nostalgia for the classics with elements of modern game design.

Traveler Arena — is an arcade roguelike where gladiators fight for survival in arenas divided into three stages. Speed, precision, and risk are key. Each battle is a test of reaction and strategy. A system of artifacts and faction rewards creates a unique dynamic of fighter development with unique abilities.

Limit of endurance

A successful attack disrupts the enemy's balance, opening the door for a dash that deals devastating damage and releases energy orbs. Collecting them accelerates the buildup of the ultimate, setting the pace of the battle. A mistake is fatal, but decisive action is rewarded with power. The higher the pressure, the greater the potential for an explosion.

Collected artifacts shape your style and influence your stat development. From speed to strength, each combination creates a new approach to combat. Reputation unlocks faction rewards that enhance your build. Progress is felt in every encounter, where victory becomes more than just a goal, but proof of superiority.

Features of the game

A roguelike with an emphasis on close combat and fighter development. Dashes, ultimate attacks and rhythm control. Over 200 artifacts for creating assemblies. Faction bonuses and progression system.
